entry.title: Awesome Playwright Updates on Feb 12 - Feb 18, 2024
entry.content:
Utils

  • POMWright (⭐48) - TypeScript-based framework designed for creating and maintaining Page Object Models. It streamlines locator management by automatically generating nested/chained locators from flat and atomic locator structures which can be dynamically updated throughout tests. This significantly reduces code duplication and makes tests easier to read, write, and maintain.
